run_plm_generation: run the multimodal language model to generate text from an image or video using a checkpoint
run_sample_tokens: run sample_tokens to select next tokens from logits using temperature top_p or top_k sampling
run_pack_prompts: run pack_prompts to concatenate multiple prompt sequences into a single packed tensor with lengths
run_batch_prompts: run batch_prompts to group prompts into batches that fit within a maximum token budget
run_load_consolidated_model: run load_consolidated_model_and_tokenizer to download and load a PLM model with its tokenizer from a checkpoint
